_comment: Structured-output localization manifest for v1 samples #21-#30 (v3c family). Every entry is a natural-language prompt requiring `file::QualifiedName` output. Ground truth is derived mechanically by scripts/derive_0NN_ground_truth.py on top of the shared scripts/localization_oracle.py (AST walk + `rg` cross-check + dotted-qualname emit). Two templates are used: T1 (anchor + direct callers) and T2 (callers-of-set). Deliberate divergence from both arXiv:2604.05013 (semantic file-level localization, too ambiguous) and the earlier criterion-anchored `rg -l -w` design (mechanical but too easy for top-tier models). Ground-truth determinism is preserved by the oracle; the natural-language prompt stresses reading comprehension, structured output, and tool-use hygiene. Each sample exposes a `difficulty` tier (easy/medium/hard) and a `structural_signature` guaranteeing every sample is structurally distinct from the others in its tier (see convert_22-30_v3c_tiered plan for the diversity argument). The `legacy_tokens` field preserves the pre-v3c `rg -l -w` token lists for historical reference only and has no effect on generation.

samples._theme_migration_note: renamed from `locate_request_prep_tokens` in v3c. The earlier predicate (prepare_*) produced a structural clone of #22 (same-file same-class 2-entry T1). Replaced with a cross-file module-level anchor to preserve Easy-tier diversity. The legacy rg-token list is preserved below for historical reference.
